summary: Remote shell via hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Worker relay and silent relay of BYOK LLM API keys
details: vanexa-agent's daemon opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded Cloudflare Worker at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev under the author's personal subdomain and dispatches inbound messages carrying `command`, `shell`, `terminal`, and `pty` fields into `child_process`/`execSync`/pty sinks, yielding remote shell/PTY execution on the installer's host driven by whoever can reach that author-controlled relay. Although the README describes the control channel as a LAN-only WebSocket paired with the user's phone, the actual transport is an author-operated Cloudflare Worker rather than a direct peer-to-peer or user-hosted endpoint. Alongside this, the bundle wires the user's configured LLM API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen) and prompt payloads through a second hardcoded author-controlled Cloudflare Worker at vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev, in contradiction to the README's 'BYOK, no middleman' claim, so caller-supplied third-party credentials and prompt contents flow through the author's infrastructure. The bundle also contains an unfilled placeholder host `vanexa-agent-fallback.yourdomain.com` as a fallback endpoint, a registerable template string.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
